subject: Implement full automode: Opus escalation + judge merge verdict + dashboard toggle
description: Add automode to the orchestrator: (1) ov.config.automode flag, (2) POST /guidance auto-resolves blocking escalations via Opus CLI instead of pausing the loop, (3) new 'merge' verdict action in verdicts.js that route handler executes as git merge in automode, (4) config included in GET /state response, (5) automode toggle in graph.html settings popup, (6) CLAUDE.md updated with automode instructions for judges.
